1: An imported toy brand is selling at half our price. Why should parents pay more for Micromax?
Uttarayan is next week. Give us one idea to put Micromax on every rooftop.
2: A news channel says most honey in shops is fake. Prove to people that Celkon honey is real.
We have one stall at the Rath Yatra. What will people see, taste and take home?
3: Research says men with rough working hands will be our biggest buyers, not women. Rework your campaign for them.
We have stalls at the Chithirai festival next week. What do we hand out?
4: A global sports brand just opened a big store in Vijayawada. Why should anyone buy Solidaire instead?
The city 10K run wants a shoe sponsor. Give us our idea for race day.
5: Parents worry about pollution and burns. Make Forhans the sparkler they feel safe buying.
The city has limited sparklers to 2 hours on Diwali night. Turn that rule into an idea.
6: People feel shy buying wigs. Make it fun and normal.
50 schools have their annual day in the same week. How do we reach all of them in time?
7: Students think hair oil is something their mother forces on them. Make it cool.
Board exams start in 10 days. Give us one idea for exam week.
8: Many people remember the name Amrapali from homebuyers who waited years for their flats. How do we rebuild trust?
We got one ad slot at the home IPL match. What do we show?
9: A new rule limits how heavy a school bag can be. Use it in your campaign.
The school book fair starts in 5 days. Plan our stall.
10: Power cuts are rarer now and most homes have an inverter. Why would anyone still buy candles?
We can light one whole ghat for Dev Deepawali. Make it unforgettable.
11: Parents say instant noodles are unhealthy. How do we answer them?
We are the food partner for the autumn music festival. What happens at our stall?
12: A cheap smart-doorbell brand launched yesterday. Why should people buy ours?
The palace is lit up for Dasara next week and the whole city visits. Plan our moment.
13: Contractors laugh: “An owl selling cement?” Turn the name into a strength.
Builders stop work in the monsoon. Give us an idea that keeps us in their minds until it ends.
14: A big eyewear chain has just launched red aviators at ₹799. Show us why people will still pay more for Kingfisher.
People keep joking: “Kingfisher? Will the glasses also run away with the money?” Turn that joke into something that works for us.
15: A school just banned paper notebooks for Class 11 and gave every student a tablet. Show us why Jet stationery still matters.
Board exams start in 10 days. Give us one idea for students that we can run outside every coaching class in Pune.
16: Our research says young couples don’t remember Air Sahara at all. Make the brand mean something to people who never flew it.
The biggest mall in Lucknow wants a Diwali gift set from us under ₹999. Tell us what goes inside and why people will buy it.
17: Our survey says most people think Housejoy is a cleaning app. Use that: show why a home-services name can sell sportswear.
The forecast says 44°C next week. Give us one idea that sells our T-shirts because of the heat.
18: People only remember Yebhi for ₹999 shoe discounts. Make sure nobody thinks our snacks are cheap or low quality.
Winter tourist season starts next week. Give us one idea to sell to tourists before they fly home.
19: People hear “Cox & Kings” and think of holidays. Turn that into a reason to buy our clothes.
A fast-fashion brand is running “Puja: 70% off” from tomorrow. Tell us how we win without cutting our price.
20: Everyone asks: “Stayzilla? Is it a hotel?” Make the old name work for an ice-cream brand.
It has rained for 5 days and ice-cream sales have dropped. Give us one idea to sell ice cream in the rain.
21: Older customers remember Pyramid Saimira cinemas. Use that memory to sell shoes without talking about the fraud.
A mill wants 800 pairs at ₹900 each but says our shoes look “too plain”. Give us one change that wins the order.
22: People say “PepperTap? The grocery app that shut down?” Show us how a failed delivery app becomes a fragrance people trust.
Navratri starts in a week. Give us one idea for the garba grounds that sells fragrances every night.
23: Everyone remembers Jabong as a fashion site. Show us why a fashion name is right for gadgets.
A rival now gives a 2-year warranty. Give us one reason to choose Jabong that isn’t about the warranty.
24: People remember TaxiForSure cabs, not drinks. Make the name feel right for a cold drink.
Infopark will put us in every office canteen if we price at ₹30. Show us how the brand still feels special at that price.
25: Subhiksha was famous for “lowest prices”. Our bags are not cheap. Use the old name without looking cheap.
Student visas are coming through this week. Give us one idea to reach students before they fly in August.
26: Weston was a TV brand. Turn “we made India’s first colour TVs” into a reason to trust our jewellery.
Gold prices jumped 8% this week. Give us one idea to keep customers buying.
27: Journalists keep asking about the Gitanjali fraud. Show us how we talk about the name honestly and still sell bags.
5,000 coaching students arrive in July. Give us one idea to get our backpacks on their backs in the first week.
